name: Four Root-Section Square Pivots of Order 900
definition: Use the rooted core $B_0$, repairing tips $\alpha=128$, $\delta=290$, $\gamma=604$, and the 28-concept coordinate face $D$ containing the punctured $\gamma$-cube but omitting root neighbor $2$. Place $D$ in layer $00$, the two side extensions in layers $01,10$, $B_0$ in layer $11$, and replicate $\gamma$ on a three-vertex row of the fresh square.
parameters: The empty-row base has 897 concepts. Each punctured-square row gives 900 concepts in dimension fourteen and VC dimension five; their common completion has 901 concepts.
properties: The four omitted row traces $00,10,01,11$ delete encoded concepts $2416,2417,2418,2419$. Exactly the last class fails to peel to zero and is a two-connected rooted factor; the other three peel to zero. Every proper root-preserving pc-minor of all four peels. Their single changed support has bitmask $6531$, outside family $\{112\}$, and adjacent negative and positive omitted traces $2307,2306$.
